panels.description: New durable dead-letter jobs over the selected range, estimated from the change in the global Firestore projection (max across replicas before delta, sampled each minute). This survives pod restarts and includes events before a new pod is first scraped, unlike the per-process counter. The projection generation starts 2026-07-25; older jobs are not backfilled. Includes exhausted retries and abandoned BYOK credential waits. Dead-letter jobs are not a count of lost conversations: some already finalized inline, and BYOK abandonment preserves the conversation. Delta extrapolates range edges; short ranges or missing summary samples can be blank. A telemetry gap is not zero. A missing current summary or no successful summary in 15 minutes suppresses the stat.

panels.description: Recorded stale capture_finalization terminals in the last 3 hours: count and percentage of all capture terminal events recorded in those 3 hours (success, failure, cancelled and stale). These events are excluded from the Voice capture success-rate denominator. This is a terminal-event window, not a cohort of captures started in the window or an accepted-minus-terminal backlog. No samples in the window stays blank; this historical window does not prove current reporter health.

options.content: **Rates and deltas, not levels.** This row tracks subscription *events* (created, cancellation requested/reverted, ended, payment failed) as they happen. It does not show absolute MRR/ARR or active-subscription counts — those levels live on the **[Omi TV](https://admin.omi.me/dashboard)** board (see the dashboard links menu), sourced live from Stripe. `cancellation_requested` is the leading indicator — the moment a user decided to leave. `ended` is lagging, up to a month later. `payment_failed` is involuntary churn, operationally distinct from voluntary cancellation. Counts are webhook deliveries, which Stripe may retry — this is an operational trend signal, not billing-grade numbers. Stripe (via the Omi TV board) remains source of truth.

panels.description: Separates voluntary churn (ended after a cancellation request) from involuntary churn (payment_failed / payment_disputed). Different problems, different owners. Counts are webhook deliveries, which Stripe may retry — this is an operational trend signal, not billing-grade numbers. Stripe (via the Omi TV board) remains source of truth. `reason` is Stripe cancellation_details.reason and is only ever populated on `ended`; `payment_failed` is involuntary by construction and always carries reason="none".
